class.name: FellowVehicle3D
class.brief_description: A car or truck driven on its FellowWheel3D children: suspension, tyres, an engine, a gearbox and assists (FellowEngine).
class.description: A [RigidBody3D] driven on its [FellowWheel3D] children (three or more), after each physics step: a ray down each wheel's suspension finds the ground; over [member substeps] the suspension's spring, damper, anti-roll bar and bump stop push the body up, and each tyre pulls it with a force from its slips along and across the wheel (a magic-formula curve, times the tyre's [member FellowWheel3D.grip], the ground's friction and the wheel's load). The wheels' spin is integrated implicitly against the tyres' pull; at a standstill a tyre holds where it stands (on a slope, on a moving platform) up to its grip. The ground's velocity is taken out of the slips (moving platforms, turntables, conveyors) and a rigid ground is pushed back. The engine's torque follows a curve over its revolutions (taken from the driven wheels), with a limiter at [member max_rpm], engine braking and its inertia through the gears; the automatic gearbox shifts on the road speed, takes reverse after the car has stood half a second with the brake held (the brake then drives it backwards) and returns to first with the throttle. The differential is open or locked; traction control and anti-lock brakes keep the wheels' slip near the tyre's peak. Set [member throttle], [member brake], [member steering] and [member handbrake] from a controller. The body's linear and angular damping are replaced by none (the node's own drag stands for the air). Works with GodotPhysics3D and Jolt. See decision 0185 in FellowEngine's [code]docs/decisions[/code].

method.name: get_engine_rpm
method.description: Returns the engine's revolutions per minute (at least [member idle_rpm]).

method.name: get_gear
method.description: Returns the gear: [code]-1[/code] reverse, [code]0[/code] neutral, [code]1[/code] and up the forward gears.

method.name: get_global_stats
method.description: Returns the statistics of every vehicle since the start or [method reset_global_stats]: [code]steps[/code] (vehicles' physics steps) and [code]step_usec[/code] (their time on the CPU, in microseconds).

method.name: get_speed
method.description: Returns the speed along the body's forward axis ([code]-Z[/code]), in metres per second (negative when going backwards).

method.name: get_speed_kmh
method.description: Returns [method get_speed] in kilometres per hour.

method.name: get_stats
method.description: Returns this vehicle's state: [code]speed_kmh[/code], [code]rpm[/code], [code]gear[/code], [code]steer_deg[/code], [code]step_usec[/code] (its last step's time) and [code]wheels[/code], an array with each wheel's [code]name[/code], [code]contact[/code], [code]compression[/code], [code]load[/code] (N), [code]rpm[/code], [code]slip_ratio[/code], [code]slip_angle_deg[/code], [code]force[/code] (the tyre's, global), [code]holding[/code] (held where it stands), [code]bottomed[/code] (on the bump stop) and [code]surface_friction[/code].

method.name: set_gear
method.description: Sets the gear ([code]-1[/code] reverse to the number of [member gear_ratios]); with [member automatic] on the gearbox may change it again.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], a braked wheel is kept from locking: its brake is eased when the wheel turns more than 15% slower than the ground passes under it (not while the handbrake holds it).
The anti-roll bars' stiffness: the force pushing an axle's two wheels' suspensions towards the same compression, per metre of difference (N/m).

If [code]true[/code], the gearbox shifts by itself, from the road speed: up past [member shift_up_rpm] at full throttle (earlier with less: from 1.5 times [member shift_down_rpm] with none, never so early that the next gear would be under the shift down), down under [member shift_down_rpm], down at once with the throttle floored when the lower gear has room (kickdown), at least 1.5 s in a gear; into reverse after the car has stood still 0.5 s with the brake held, no throttle and the handbrake off (the brake then drives it backwards), back to first with the throttle.
The brake pedal, from [code]0[/code] to [code]1[/code] (with [member automatic], it drives the car backwards once it is in reverse).
The brakes' torque on each braked wheel at a full [member brake] (N·m).
How the driven wheels share the engine's torque.
The body's lift coefficient times its area (m²): a downward force growing with the square of the speed.
The body's drag coefficient times its frontal area (m²): the air's drag against the velocity, growing with its square.
The share of the engine's torque that reaches the wheels.
The engine's friction against its turning at [member max_rpm] with the throttle closed (N·m, proportional to its revolutions): the car slows when the throttle lifts.
The engine's, flywheel's and clutch's moment of inertia (kg·m²), felt at the driven wheels through the gears (times the ratio squared).
The final drive's ratio, after the gearbox's.
The forward gears' ratios, first to last.
If [code]true[/code], the handbrake holds the wheels with [member FellowWheel3D.handbrake] on.
The handbrake's torque on each wheel it holds (N·m).
The engine's idle revolutions: the lowest it turns at (a slipping clutch below).
The speed the car goes backwards at most (m/s): the engine's torque is faded out towards it.
The engine's highest revolutions: no torque past them (the limiter).
The steered wheels' largest angle (degrees) at a full [member steering], at a standstill.
The engine's largest torque (N·m), at [member peak_rpm] with the built-in curve.
The revolutions of the built-in torque curve's peak.
The reverse gear's ratio.
With [member automatic]: the revolutions (of the road speed in the gear) under which it shifts down.
Seconds a shift takes, without drive.
With [member automatic]: the revolutions (of the road speed in the gear) past which it shifts up at full throttle (earlier with less).
The share of [member max_steer] left at 100 km/h (less steering at speed, linearly from a standstill).
How fast the steered wheels turn towards the asked angle (radians a second).
The steering, from [code]-1[/code] to [code]1[/code]; positive steers left (as [VehicleBody3D]'s).
The substeps of each physics step in which the suspension, the tyres and the wheels' spin are worked out.
The throttle, from [code]0[/code] to [code]1[/code].

The engine's torque over its revolutions divided by [member max_rpm], as a share of [member max_torque]; empty: a built-in curve (55% at idle rising to all of it at [member peak_rpm], 80% at [member max_rpm]).
If [code]true[/code], a driven wheel is kept from spinning: the drive is cut (and the wheel braked) when it turns more than 15% faster than the ground passes under it.

signal.name: gear_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the automatic gearbox shifts up or down.

constants.constant: The driven wheels get the same torque and turn freely of each other.
Each axle's driven wheels turn together.
